_readme: [pt19h-quest] The SHIPPED click-free quest-entry TABLE (PROTOCOL 10.26, extended beyond the enlistment rows of lib/lrg_factions.php). Data only; read by lrgFacQeRows(). A row is the voice fallback for ONE scripted player line whose whole fragment is Quest.SetStage(n) (decoded by the pt19x coverage team, research/pt19x-coverage/scripted_entry_candidates.json, use=entry, graded plain). It goes out ONLY when the driver cannot click: menuless questing off for her (ml=0), or she is an ambient scene actor the game cannot open on (lrgFacOpenImpossible: io off, the last open refused, no click verified yet, too far, combat) or whose open would not bring this line (lrgFacQeOpenBrings: an open brings it only when her cached root list carries it, or no list of hers is known and `top` = 1 - the line sits on a top-level topic of hers and has enough meaning words for the open's top-level clause; a deeper line, `top` = 0, is on no list an open brings); never while a menu of hers is open and never for an ordinary NPC with menuless on (the E-press and the pre-LLM open carry the real line - the v1.0 visible menu wins). It fires only on HIS explicit sentence: after fillers, her name and titles are stripped, his words must EQUAL the line or one of `words` (never containment, never similarity); a statement line never fires on a question or an echo (a trailing '?'), a line never on a refusal, a deferral, a hedge or a bargain. The server checks a fresh facts line (qst= <quest>:<stage> younger than quest_entry.require_facts_fresh): the quest must be on it, at or below `conds.max` and below `stage`, nothing of this row pending. The GAME re-checks every `conds` key on the live forms (LRG_Main.CmdQuestEntry, script 510+: isid = the speaker's actor base, low 24 bits, decimal; notdone = stages of the quest that must not be done; max = the highest current stage allowed - never lower a quest; qdone = quests that must be complete; qnd = quest:stage pairs that must not be done) - ONLY these keys ship: a row carrying any other key is skipped whole. `conds` is the line's own INFO conditions AND every condition on one TCLT path from a real top-level player topic down to it, with no fragment on any line of that path (research/pt19h-quest.md has the decode). Rows are never licensed: the model is told the game has NOT confirmed it yet, and the game's own OK is voiced from `meaning` (the fact) and `say` (her one line) - never both. `hint` is the corner note after the stage is set (bQuestHint). `evidence` is comment only, never sent.
